instruction: Convert the receipt image located at /home/user/OIP.jpg into a PDF document and save it as 'receipt.pdf' on the desktop.

metadata.explanation: Task requires converting receipt image to PDF. Evaluator checks: (1) PDF exists at correct location, (2) Has exactly 1 page, (3) File size > 10KB, (4) Contains embedded images. Partial credit: 0.5 for correct page count, 1.0 for all checks passing.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: 0.5 for correct page count, 1.0 for content verification passed
